instruction: Undo the recent tab closure in the browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (spotify.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 entertainment/streaming websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_open_tabs_info) correctly extracts all currently open tab URLs and titles from Chrome via CDP
Metric (is_expected_tabs) properly compares expected URLs against actual open tab URLs using are_lists_equal with URL comparison
Complete coverage: evaluator checks for all 3 required tabs (Netflix, YouTube, Spotify) after undo operation
Expected values are semantically correct: all 3 URLs should be present after successfully undoing the Spotify tab closure
State accessibility: getter can access open tabs at evaluation time without requiring postconfig
Verification logic is sound: presence of all 3 tabs correctly indicates successful undo of tab closure
